question.question_text: Does this plan criterion follow from the tasks and decisions it cites?

content.text: The complete brief and assessment retain criterion-export unchanged and link factual evidence from inspection of authenticated tenant-scoped question/evidence routes and direct-provider readback through HTTP response bodies, distinguishing a production capture from any claim that provider grading occurred; exact focused-check counts and all checkout, file, credential, failure, and skip gaps are reported.

content.description: Produce exactly one oakridge cohort named slice whose plan and complete brief preserve criterion-lineage, criterion-export, and decision-capture; make both criteria cite decision-capture and carry the criterion IDs unchanged into assessment.

Through gated-review, confirm the current status and head of existing PR #771 on cohort/live-verification/bc33be immediately before factual publication, audit that exact PR-head snapshot when possible, and report the checked-out commit separately from the PR head without changing source history.

Inspect the authenticated tenant-scoped question/evidence API routes and direct-provider HTTP response-body readback for criterion-export, distinguishing capture evidence from any claim that provider grading already occurred.

Against the exact audited PR head, run only the gated-review tools smoke test, workflow-config definitions tests, and observation grading-records/direct-provider tests; publish exact pass, failure, and skip counts and record unavailable checkout, absent files, missing credentials, or other gaps without broad-suite substitution.

Publish the builder's honest build_result first, then publish the existing PR #771 as the pr artifact; override the generic builder workflow by making no edits, commits, pushes, new PRs, merges, database resets, deployments, or gated-review server changes.

Assess the existing PR code factually against criterion-lineage and criterion-export, retaining both criterion IDs and linking the findings to the evidence actually produced, including failures, skips, credential gaps, and absent files.

content.text: Preserve the production publisher wire payloads exactly in a newly produced capture and use authenticated HTTP response bodies for stored-record readback; do not substitute fixtures, direct SQL, or an unsupported claim that provider grading already occurred.
